title: BYD Auto and Xperi Announce Adoption of DTS AutoStage™ as Exclusive In‑Car Media Platform for BYD Vehicles
summary: Largest Global Manufacturer of Electric Vehicles Becomes 14th Automotive OEM to Adopt Best-in-Class DTS AutoStage Platform BYD (H.K.) CO., Limited, the world’s largest manufacturer of electric vehicles, and Xperi Inc. (NYSE: XPER), an entertainment technology company that invents, develops and delivers technologies that enable extraordinary entertainment experiences, today announced that BYD has adopted DTS AutoStage™ as its exclusive in‑car media platform, bringing advanced audio and video entertainment experiences to future BYD vehicles across BYD's major international markets in Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, the Middle East and Africa. DTS AutoStage supports both audio and video entertainment capabilities, with feature availability varying by vehicle model, region and product configuration.
